rows.ja: 顧客(組立・テスト先として採用)

companies.name: ラティス・セミコンダクター

relations.text: Latticeの年次報告が、主要な組立委託先の1社としてAmkorを挙げている
relations.text_en: Lattice's 10-K lists Amkor as one of two qualified major assembly partners

source.label: Lattice Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: We have qualified two major assembly partners, ASE and Amkor Technology ("Amkor") and are second sourced where volume and customer requirements make it necessary.

relations.text: LatticeのASEとAmkorでの製造はすべてアジアで行われている
relations.text_en: All of Lattice's ASE and Amkor manufacturing is in Asia

source.label: Lattice Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: All ASE and Amkor manufacturing of our products is in Asia.

relations.text: Astera LabsはAmkorを使って集積回路を組立・パッケージ・テストしている
relations.text_en: Astera Labs uses Amkor to assemble, package, and test its integrated circuits

source.label: Astera Labs 10-K
source.quote: We also use Advanced Semiconductor Engineering and Amkor Technologies to assemble, package, and test our integrated circuits.

companies.name: クレド・テクノロジー

relations.text: Credoは、ファウンドリー後のパッケージ・組立・テストにAmkorを含む外部業者を使っている
relations.text_en: Credo uses third-party contractors including Amkor for packaging, assembly and testing

source.label: Credo 10-K
source.quote: Upon the completion of processing at the foundry, we use third-party contractors for packaging, assembly and testing, including Amkor Technology Inc.

relations.text: Qualcommの年次報告が、主な組立・テスト委託先の1社としてAmkorを挙げている
relations.text_en: Qualcomm's 10-K names Amkor among its primary assembly and test suppliers

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K
source.quote: Our primary semiconductor assembly and test suppliers are Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Amkor Technology, Siliconware Precision Industries and STATSChipPAC.

relations.text: AppleとQualcommへの直接販売は、2025年12月期の純売上高のそれぞれ29.8%と11.1%を占める
relations.text_en: Direct sales to Apple and Qualcomm were 29.8% and 11.1% of Amkor's 2025 net sales, respectively

source.label: Amkor Technology 10-K
source.quote: Direct sales to Apple and Qualcomm accounted for 29.8% and 11.1% of our net sales, respectively, for the year ended December 31, 2025.

companies.name: ブロードコム
companies.sub: 通信・ソフト向け半導体

relations.text: Broadcomは、組立・テストの委託先の1社にAmkorを含めている
relations.text_en: Broadcom lists Amkor among its contract manufacturers for assembly and test

source.label: Broadcom 10-K
source.quote: We use third-party CMs for a significant majority of our assembly and test operations, including TSMC, Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc., Foxconn Technology Group, Amkor Technology, Inc. and Siliconware Precision Industries Co., Ltd.

relations.text: Cirrus Logicは、主な組立・テスト業者の1社としてAmkorを挙げている
relations.text_en: Cirrus Logic lists Amkor among its primary assembly and test houses

source.label: Cirrus Logic 10-K
source.quote: The Company’s primary assembly and test houses include Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc., Amkor Technology, Inc., STATS ChipPAC Pte.

relations.text: AppleへのAmkorの直接販売は、2025年12月期の純売上高の29.8%を占める
relations.text_en: Direct sales to Apple were 29.8% of Amkor's net sales for 2025

source.label: Amkor Technology 10-K
source.quote: Direct sales to Apple and Qualcomm accounted for 29.8% and 11.1% of our net sales, respectively, for the year ended December 31, 2025.

relations.text: AppleのCOOが、TSMCの新工場で作られるApple向けシリコンをAmkorがパッケージする日を待つと述べている
relations.text_en: Apple's COO says Apple looks forward to Amkor packaging Apple silicon produced at TSMC's new facility

source.label: Amkor Technology 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: They deliver the quality and scale our products demand and we can't wait until they are packaging the Apple silicon produced just down the road at TSMC’s new facility.” ―Sabih Khan | COO, Apple “ © 2026 Amkor Technology, Inc. 24

relations.text: TSMCとAmkorは、アジアでの長年の提携先で、アリゾナでの協業でそれを米国に広げる
relations.text_en: TSMC and Amkor are long-standing partners in Asia, and their Arizona collaboration extends this to the United States

source.label: Amkor Technology 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: TSMC and Amkor have been long-standing, trusted partners in Asia, and our collaboration in Arizona extends this partnership to the United States.

companies.name: バンク・オブ・アメリカ

relations.text: Amkorの与信契約(2025年5月9日付)でBank of America, N.A.が管理代理人を務める
relations.text_en: Bank of America, N.A. is administrative agent under Amkor's credit agreement dated May 9, 2025

source.label: Amkor Technology 10-K
source.quote: 10.40 Credit Agreement, dated May 9, 2025, among Amkor Technology, Inc, as the Borrower, the Lenders party thereto from time to time, the L/C Issuers party thereto from time to time and Bank of America, N.A., as the Administrative Agent.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 同契約の第1次修正(2025年6月27日付)でも同行が管理代理人を務める
relations.text_en: Bank of America, N.A. is also administrative agent under the first amendment dated June 27, 2025

source.label: Amkor Technology 10-K
source.quote: 10.41 First Amendment to Credit Agreement, dated June 27, 2025, among Amkor Technology, Inc., as the Borrower, the Guarantors, the Non-Loan Party Equity Pledgor, the Term A-1 Lenders, the Revolving Lenders party thereto and Bank of America, N.A., as Administrative Agent.

companies.name: ASEテクノロジー・ホールディング

relations.text: アムコー・テクノロジーの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in Amkor Technology’s annual report

source.label: Amkor Technology 10-K
source.quote: We face competition from established packaging and test service providers primarily located in Asia, including ASE Technology, JCET Group and Powertech Technology.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
